tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs, slide cards, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: App chrome: title bar, ribbon tab row, slide rail. Page background.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Hovered ribbon button, table header, quiet fills.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Pressed state; stage (editing canvas) backdrop behind the slide.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: ribbon group dividers, panel edges.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders that must be seen: 3:1 on surface and surface-100 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-100, surface-200 (13:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ribbon group labels, captions, slide numbers. 6:1+ on surface to surface-200.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only; never carries information.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Indigo. Primary buttons, File button, active tab underline, selected thumbnail ring.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed for brand fills.

tokens.name: brand-subtle
tokens.usage: Pressed toggles, selected rows, brand tints.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-hover fills (6:1+).

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured text on surface or brand-subtle: active tab label, links.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring, offset 2px.

tokens.name: guide
tokens.usage: Smart guides, snap lines and distance labels over the slide. Orange to separate from indigo selection; same in both themes because the slide stays light (4.3:1 on slide-bg).

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selection box and resize/rotate handles over the slide; same in both themes (7.9:1 on slide-bg).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved, export complete.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Unsaved-changes dot, compatibility notices.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, file errors.

tokens.name: slide-bg
tokens.usage: Default slide paper; stays white in dark mode since slides render their own theme.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Modal scrim.
